newsitem.title: USA: Mylan says FDA clears generic Glynase.
newsitem.headline: Mylan says FDA clears generic Glynase.

text.p: Mylan Laboratories Inc said on Friday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration granted the company clearance to make and market the first generic version of Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc's Glynase tablets in 1.5- and 3.0-milligram strengths.

The drug, with the generic name glyburide, is used as an adjunct to diet to lower the blood glucose in patients with non-insulin dependent diabetes mellitus, known as type II diabetes, whose hyperglycemia cannot be satisfactorily controlled by diet alone.
